Problem: a soccer ball is kicked from the ground at 20 m/s at 35 degrees above horizontal. Find (a) time of flight (b) range (c) max height. Ignore air resistance. My work:

vx = 20cos35 = 16.38 m/s
vy = 20sin35 = 11.47 m/s
(a) t = 2vy/g = 2(11.47)/9.8 = 2.34 s
(b) R = vx * t = 16.38 * 2.34 = 38.3 m
(c) H = v^2/(2g) = 400/19.6 = 20.4 m

Does this look right?
